items.title: A filtering family of subfields of a power series fraction field with intersection the p-th powers
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a filtering family of subfields of the fraction field of a power series ring over a field of characteristic p, indexed by finite subsets of a p-basis, and verifies the three hypotheses of the intersection statement of the same block; it also records that the corresponding ring extensions are finite. The proof is a 26-line argument: finiteness of the ring extension comes from the finiteness of the power series extension after a finite extension of the base, and then the three properties are checked one by one, the second being the substantial one, where an element contained in every K_J is shown to lie in the p-th powers by applying derivations with respect to the power series variables and a derivation of the base field and using that the ring is a domain. The derivation argument is carried out in detail.
